newsitem.title: UK: Scott Pickford, Aerodata shr swap.
newsitem.headline: Scott Pickford, Aerodata shr swap.

text.p: The UK's Scott Pickford Plc said on on Friday that Australia's Aerodata Holdings Ltd would buy 2.5 million of its 10p shares at 48 pence each which would give it a 20 percent stake in the current share capital of the British company.
Scott Pickford would in turn be offered 1.873 million shares in Aerodata at A$0.50 each amounting to 4.3 percent of the current issued share capital, the companies said in a joint statement.
Scott Pickford specialises in geoscience and engineering while Aerodata provides airborne geophysical data and related services for mineral and oil exploration.
Both companies had an informal arrnagement by which they shared some of their inputs regarding remote sensing methods.

"There is now a general consensus within Scott Pickford and Aerodata that a joint approach to marketing each company's services to the oil exploration industry would be commercially advantageous to both companies," the joint statment said.
